title: Within-record rate–variability coupling: an exploratory cross-database heart-failure prediction test
abstract: Adding across-window log meanNN–log RMSSD correlation changed external CHF-versus-normal Brier loss by +0.00293 (joint record bootstrap 95% [-0.00899, 0.02285]) beyond conventional HRV, a six-hour SDANN analogue and RMSSD heterogeneity. The registered uncertainty criterion for incremental benefit was not met.
